lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I have a problem I cannot fit into a tidy calendar slot.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That sounds unlike you. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: I promised to organize the community study night, and the room booking collapsed. I know how to fix plans, but I am less practiced at asking people for help.

lines.speaker: elena
lines.text: Would you be willing to look at the alternatives with me when you are free?

choices.label: I can help you think it through.
choices.reply: Thank you. I will bring the messy draft, not just the polished version.

choices.label: I am busy today, but you can ask others too.
choices.reply: You are right. Asking is not an imposition, even when the answer is no.
